opzioni.title: What do you want to enable?

reauth_confirm.title: Password no longer valid
reauth_confirm.description: Argo rejected the password of {utente}. Enter it again (until then the integration does not retry, to avoid locking the account).

data.ora: Default time (for days without their own time)
data.unisci_alunni: One PDF for students with the same homework

data_description.max_pagine: Hard limit: if the content does not fit, extra items are not printed (and the PDF says so).
data_description.cartella: Suggested: a randomly named subfolder of /config/www, already allowed by Home Assistant. WARNING: /config/www is PUBLIC (files are reachable at /local/… without login by anyone who knows the address) and the PDFs contain students' data: the random name makes the address hard to guess, but does not protect it. For a private folder use another existing folder allowed in allowlist_external_dirs (see README).
data_description.nome_file: One PDF is generated per student. If {alunno} is missing it is appended. Without {data} the file is overwritten each time.
data_description.unisci_alunni: Students in the same class with identical homework, reminders and notices share one PDF, with all their names. Grades and notes stay separate per student.
